notes: Read SKILL.md and references/database-operations.md, elastic-pools.md, server-management.md in full. The skill is an SDK reference for Azure.ResourceManager.Sql (.NET) management-plane operations: servers, databases, elastic pools, firewall and VNet rules, backup/restore, auditing and TDE.

The only commands are `dotnet add package Azure.ResourceManager.Sql` / `Azure.Identity` (official Microsoft packages) plus a table of related packages; all other content is C# sample code for the user's application with placeholder names, passwords and storage keys. The agent is not instructed to provision, modify or delete Azure resources itself or to handle real secrets.

Samples hardcode placeholder admin passwords and storage keys (e.g. SKILL.md:94, database-operations.md:193-196) while SKILL.md:283 warns never to hardcode passwords in production; some samples are destructive or weaken security if copied as-is (deleting every database in a pool at elastic-pools.md:197-204, disabling TDE at database-operations.md:244-249, broad firewall rules at SKILL.md:174-196), so users should adapt them deliberately.
